# Visual Teaching Patterns

## State-flow diagram
Use for forward propagation, training loops, request flows, data pipelines, and agent workflows.

## Before/after curve
Use to reveal effects of learning rate, regularization, data augmentation, architecture changes, or optimization choices.

## Decision-boundary animation
Use to show how parameters change classification behavior.

## Matrix/tensor shape map
Use to make vectorization and layer dimensions concrete.

## Error heatmap or confusion matrix
Use to reveal where aggregate accuracy hides important failures.

## Feature-map progression
Use for CNNs or learned representations: input -> low-level pattern -> higher-level feature.

## Attention/token map
Use sparingly to illustrate relationships in Transformer-style models; explain limitations of interpreting attention as a complete explanation.

## Resource trade-off chart
Plot or tabulate quality against latency, memory, throughput, model size, or cost to reinforce engineering trade-offs.
